0.title: Precision is checked

2.title: Stress relief is included
2.description: The wheel is stress-relieved before the last tension and true check, helping the build settle.

3.title: Dish and alignment are verified
3.description: Hub position, rim center, and dish are checked against the selected frame and drivetrain setup.

5.title: Final quality check
